response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, deep technical curiosity, and a track record of building scalable systems and open-source tools, but lacks explicit evidence of leading enterprise-scale experimentation platforms, AI-driven growth systems, or cross-team instrumentation frameworks required for the Principal role.
strengths: Proven full-stack expertise across JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, C#, and Java with production scale experience.
Demonstrated ability to build and ship open-source infrastructure tools (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts) used by real teams.
Strong technical leadership through workshops, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration on testing and CI/CD.
concerns: No clear evidence of designing or owning experimentation frameworks, feature flagging, or growth measurement systems at scale.
Limited visibility into AI tooling usage to accelerate engineering velocity or data-driven decision systems.
Experience with telemetry, guardrails, and risk controls in experimentation is implied but not explicitly documented.
